description: Phase 5 — Scotty Upload & Mutation Journal: implement schema.sql, journal.py, and tests/test_journal.py. The journal is the SQLite state machine enforcing safe mutation semantics. Depends on FEAT-001. Independent of FEAT-002/003/004; FEAT-005 imports from journal.py but that import is not required to be complete before this FEAT runs.
steps: Create src/mcp_gateway/storage/schema.sql at /home/williamdeldaymarketing/Projects/Google Notebook MCP/src/mcp_gateway/storage/schema.sql. SQL content: (a) PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL; PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON; (b) Table mutation_journal: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mutation_journal (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, request_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, notebook_id TEXT NOT NULL, operation_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(operation_type IN ('add_source','query_notebook')), payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'prepared' CHECK(state IN ('prepared','sent','confirmed','rejected','unknown')), assigned_source_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')), updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))); (c) Table mutation_events: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mutation_events (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, mutation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES mutation_journal(id), event_type TEXT NOT NULL, old_state TEXT, new_state TEXT, detail TEXT, occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))); (d) Index: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mutation_journal_request_key ON mutation_journal(request_key); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mutation_events_mutation_id ON mutation_events(mutation_id). All queries use parameterized placeholders — ZERO string interpolation.

Create src/mcp_gateway/storage/journal.py at /home/williamdeldaymarketing/Projects/Google Notebook MCP/src/mcp_gateway/storage/journal.py. Implement: (a) Enum MutationState(str, Enum): PREPARED='prepared', SENT='sent', CONFIRMED='confirmed', REJECTED='rejected', UNKNOWN='unknown'. (b) Enum OperationType(str, Enum): ADD_SOURCE='add_source', QUERY_NOTEBOOK='query_notebook'. (c) Dataclass (frozen=True) MutationRecord with fields: id: int, request_key: str, notebook_id: str, operation_type: OperationType, payload_hash: str, state: MutationState, assigned_source_id: str | None, created_at: str, updated_at: str. (d) Function compute_payload_hash(args: dict[str,Any], capability_secret: bytes) -> str — canonicalizes args as json.dumps(args, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')), computes HMAC-SHA256 with capability_secret as key, returns hex digest. (e) Class MutationJournal: __init__(db_path: Path) — opens sqlite3.connect(str(db_path), check_same_thread=False), sets isolation_level=None (autocommit off), calls _apply_schema(). Method _apply_schema() -> None — reads schema.sql relative to this file, executes with executescript(). Method prepare(request_key: str, notebook_id: str, operation_type: OperationType, args: dict[str,Any], capability_secret: bytes) -> MutationRecord — within explicit transaction: checks if request_key already exists (idempotency: returns existing record if state is not rejected); INSERTs new row in prepared state; inserts mutation_events row; returns MutationRecord. USES ONLY PARAMETERIZED QUERIES. Method transition(request_key: str, new_state: MutationState, assigned_source_id: str | None = None) -> MutationRecord — within explicit transaction: fetches current record; validates transition is legal (prepared->sent, sent->confirmed|rejected|unknown only — NEVER sent->prepared, NEVER auto-replay from sent); UPDATEs state and updated_at; inserts event row; returns updated MutationRecord. Raises ValueError on illegal transitions. CRITICAL: a record in 'sent' state can ONLY transition to confirmed, rejected, or unknown — never back to prepared or sent. Method get(request_key: str) -> MutationRecord | None. Method list_by_notebook(notebook_id: str) -> list[MutationRecord]. All methods use parameterized SQL exclusively — zero f-strings or % formatting in SQL strings. (f) Full type annotations throughout.

Create tests/test_journal.py at /home/williamdeldaymarketing/Projects/Google Notebook MCP/tests/test_journal.py. Tests: (a) test_prepare_creates_record — call journal.prepare(), assert record state == PREPARED. (b) test_idempotent_prepare — call prepare() twice with same request_key, assert second call returns same record (no duplicate row). (c) test_transition_prepared_to_sent — prepare(), transition to SENT, assert state updated. (d) test_transition_sent_to_confirmed — prepare(), sent, confirmed — assert state chain. (e) test_transition_sent_to_unknown — prepare(), sent, unknown — assert NEVER auto-replayed (i.e., calling transition(SENT) on an UNKNOWN record raises ValueError). (f) test_sent_cannot_go_to_prepared — prepare(), sent, assert ValueError on transition(PREPARED). (g) test_sent_cannot_replay — prepare(), sent, assert ValueError on transition(SENT) again. (h) test_payload_hash_deterministic — same args dict always produces same hash. (i) test_payload_hash_secret_dependent — different capability_secret produces different hash. (j) test_sql_injection_in_request_key — use request_key="'; DROP TABLE mutation_journal; --" and confirm prepare() succeeds without error (parameterized query prevents injection) and record exists. (k) All tests use a tmp_path fixture for db_path — no shared state.
Update src/mcp_gateway/storage/__init__.py to export MutationJournal, MutationRecord, MutationState, OperationType, compute_payload_hash.

Wire journal into broker.py: in BrokerDaemon.__init__, instantiate MutationJournal from storage. In _handle_batchexecute and _handle_query_stream for mutation operations: call journal.prepare() before sending, journal.transition(SENT) just before forwarding to native host, journal.transition(CONFIRMED/REJECTED/UNKNOWN) based on response. On timeout: ALWAYS transition to UNKNOWN, never CONFIRMED. In McpFacade.query_notebook handler: extract request_key from input, pass to broker. In McpFacade.add_source handler: extract idempotency_key, pass as request_key.

uv run mypy --strict src/ reports zero errors across all modules
